Guidance & outlook: Profit before tax and Profit after tax were ` 32.28 Crores and ` 27.54 Crores respectively for the FY 2025-26 as against ` 39.11 Crores and ` 30.70 Crores respectively in in FY 2024- 25 which can be mainly attributed to mark to market loss of investment in mutual fund.
(iii) CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS/ SUMMARY During FY 2025-26, total income of the Company was ` 2,326 Crores as compared to ` 2,098 Crores in FY 2024- 25, showing increase of about 10.87%.
Profit before tax and Profit after tax were ` 63.04 Crores and ` 46.15 Crores respectively for the FY 2025-26 as against ` 46.39 Crores and ` 39.07 Crores respectively in FY 2024-25.
Growth & demand: Private consumption growth rose to 10.5% in 2025 (from 8% in 2022-24), aided by tax relief, GST cuts, easing inflation and lower rates.
Full-year private final consumption expenditure grew 7.7%, with retail inflation averaging just 2.5% over the first ten months of 2025 versus 4.9% a year earlier, boosting purchasing power.

Two-wheelers, closest to MAIL's core business, led the upturn, with retail sales up 13.4% for the year and double-digit growth sustained through January-March 2026, confirming a structural demand shift.
